[[Company Brain]] › Concepts › Bring your own model

A bot you publish answers with ''your'' inference, so a stranger who installs it must not be able to spend it. [[Company Brain/awdiscord|awdiscord]] therefore decides, per server, whose model answers.

<span id="the-three-outcomes"></span>
== The three outcomes ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Resolves to
! Meaning
|-
| <code>owner</code>
| The bot’s configured agent answers
|-
| <code>byo</code>
| The server’s own endpoint answers
|-
| <code>none</code>
| Nothing answers here; the server gets a card explaining how to set up
|}

<span id="model-needs-manage-server"></span>
== <code>/model</code> (needs Manage Server) ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Subcommand
! Effect
|-
| <code>setup</code>
| Opens a modal for endpoint, model, API key and optional vision models. The endpoint must pass a health check before anything is saved
|-
| <code>test</code>
| Re-checks the endpoint
|-
| <code>status</code>
| Shows what answers; the key appears only as a 12-character fingerprint
|-
| <code>off</code>
| Deletes the key and returns to the bot’s default model
|}

<code>/selfhost</code> is an admin-only wizard from “no model” to a server’s own endpoint, then hands off to <code>/model setup</code>.

<span id="works-with"></span>
== Works with ==

llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or a hosted API, as long as it is OpenAI-compatible.
